summary: Require explicit apply for recipe collection writes.
reason: The collection create, add, remove, and delete commands could send live writes without an explicit apply flag. After adding the gate, a disposable create acknowledged HTTP success but was absent from fresh AnyList data, so every collection write must remain fail-closed until the exact persistence contract is proven.
validated_outcome: Collection writes preview without --apply, accept apply:true through stdin, and fail closed before any request when live persistence proof is absent. The disposable collection create was absent on fresh read-back and a follow-up listing confirmed no residue; no collection or recipe data remains from the probe.
gate_state: Collection listing is supported; create, add, remove, and delete remain preview-only and fail-closed pending a proven live persistence contract.
